$comment: Issue #89: Fix OperatorHub listing blank icon and stale description.

criteria.target: python3 -c "import base64; b=open('bundle/manifests/jupyter-notebook-validator-operator.clusterserviceversion.yaml').read(); import re; m=re.search(r'base64data:\s+(\S+)', b); d=base64.b64decode(m.group(1)); assert len(d) > 10000 and b'IEND' in d[-12:], 'icon truncated'"

covers.declared: Icon base64 validity, Kubernetes version in description, and minKubeVersion update in bundle CSV
covers.uncovered: Helm chart description update is optional; OperatorHub.io cache refresh is external
